entity-resolution.label: eval-cat-entity-resolution
entity-resolution.defect: control/persona/skill identifiers do not resolve to canonical nodes
entity-resolution.expected: every in-corpus identifier resolves; only truly-absent ones unresolved

answer-contract.label: eval-cat-answer-contract
answer-contract.defect: can_answer / block grounding not a projection of governed evidence
answer-contract.expected: can_answer is a projection of block-level grounding, not retrieval presence

depends_on.rationale: answer grounding cannot be judged until identifiers resolve to canonical nodes

skill-routing.label: eval-cat-skill-routing
skill-routing.defect: explicit $skill commands do not route to APP_COMMAND
skill-routing.expected: a registered $skill token routes APP_COMMAND independent of app context

depends_on.rationale: skill-arg identifiers must resolve before routing is judged
